title: Moa McKay gives you a vibe you can’t deny on her new song
htmlContent:
Moa McKay  gives you a vibe you can’t deny on her new song “Dreaming”. She crafts a track that feels good to the bones and you can just enjoy the music, on this record that has a throwback feel to it that makes you vibe out forever. Her talent is on full display as her song writing shines as well as her vocals that deliver everything masterfully, to get this song to that special level.
